fatigue: Fatigue means feeling tired, exhausted, drained, worn out, low on energy, or very shag.
fever: Fever means feeling feverish, unusually hot, or having a raised body temperature.
chills: Chills means shivering, trembling, or feeling abnormally cold despite a warm room.
body_aches: Body aches means the whole body feels sore, achy, or painful in the muscles.
runny_nose: A runny nose may be described as a dripping, leaking, or watery nose.
nasal_congestion: Nasal congestion means a blocked, clogged, or stuffy nose.
sore_throat: A sore throat means throat pain, a scratchy throat, or pain when swallowing.
cough: A cough may be described as coughing, hacking, or repeatedly clearing the throat.
shortness_of_breath: Shortness of breath means breathlessness, difficulty breathing, or being unable to catch one's breath.
loss_of_appetite: Loss of appetite means not feeling hungry, having no appetite, or not wanting to eat.
nausea: Nausea means feeling queasy, sick to the stomach, or like one may vomit.
vomiting: Vomiting means throwing up, puking, or bringing food or liquid back up.
diarrhoea: Diarrhoea means frequent loose or watery stools; locally it may be described as lao sai.
bloating: Bloating means a swollen, gassy, tight, or overly full feeling in the abdomen.
heartburn: Heartburn means acid reflux, indigestion, or a burning feeling behind the chest after eating.
headache: A headache means head pain, an aching head, or saying that the head hurts.
light_sensitivity: Light sensitivity means bright light hurts or makes the symptoms worse.
sound_sensitivity: Sound sensitivity means noise feels painful or makes the symptoms worse.
painful_urination: Painful urination means pain, stinging, or a burning feeling while peeing.
frequent_urination: Frequent urination means needing to pee unusually often or repeatedly.
urinary_urgency: Urinary urgency means a sudden strong need to pee that is difficult to hold.
flank_pain: Flank pain is pain at the side of the back just below the ribs.
dehydration_signs: Dehydration may feel like a very dry mouth, intense thirst, dizziness, or passing much less urine.
confusion_drowsiness: Unusual drowsiness or confusion means being extremely sleepy, hard to wake, disoriented, or not thinking clearly.
